skill.summary: Comprehensive travel planning, booking, and management skill. Use when needing to plan international trips, manage multi-destination itineraries, handle family travel logistics, optimize travel costs, and coordinate complex travel arrangements.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of travel-manager skill with comprehensive travel planning features.

- Supports international trip planning and multi-destination itineraries
- Handles family travel logistics and age-specific needs
- Offers cost optimization and travel document management
- Includes defined workflow for efficient travel coordination
- Provides references for family travel and international document requirements
